title: Chart Feature Spec
description: One spec, either a feature (produced by the generate-chart-spec skill from gathered design tokens/requirements) or a bug (produced by the file-issue skill from an investigation), reviewed via PR, then consumed by the implement-new-* / implement-bug-fix skills. See planning/specs/README.md for the full workflow and field-by-field guidance.

id.description: Kebab-case slug, matches the filename without extension.

chartType.description: Matches an existing markType, or 'chart' for a chart-level (not mark-specific) feature/bug. Also determines the planning/specs/<chartType>/ directory the file lives in — features at planning/specs/<chartType>/<slug>.json, bugs at planning/specs/<chartType>/issues/<slug>.json. Add an 'implemented/' segment before the filename once status becomes 'implemented' (e.g. planning/specs/<chartType>/implemented/<slug>.json or .../issues/implemented/<slug>.json) — see README.md's Status lifecycle section.

kind.description: 'feature' for a not-yet-built capability (requirements/edgeCases required, filed by generate-chart-spec at planning/specs/<chartType>/<slug>.json). 'bug' for a known defect in existing behavior (symptom/rootCause required, filed by file-issue at planning/specs/<chartType>/issues/<slug>.json).

variant.description: Which package variant this spec's implementationPlan is scoped to: 's1' (vega-spec-builder / react-spectrum-charts), 's2' (vega-spec-builder-s2 / react-spectrum-charts-s2), or 'both' when the plan already covers matching files in each from the outset (e.g. a chart-level feature, or a bug confirmed in both). Distinct from crossCutting.requiresS1S2Parity, which flags whether the *other* variant (not named here) also needs matching work — see README.md.

status.description: Defaults to 'approved' — a spec only lands in main once its PR is reviewed, so draft/in-review states are represented by the PR itself, not this field. Move to 'implemented' once the feature/fix PR lands, or 'needs-revision' if the spec is found stale/wrong. For kind: 'bug', 'approved' means the bug is filed and open; 'implemented' means it's fixed. Setting status to 'implemented' also means relocating the file into the 'implemented/' subfolder of its directory in the same PR — see README.md.

score.description: 1-2 simple (plain passthrough prop), 3 moderate (new logic in one spec-builder function), 5 complex (new mark/child component or cross-cutting change). See README.md rubric.

rationale.description: Short free-text justification for the score.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence description of the feature or bug.

requirements.description: kind: 'feature' only. Behavior requirements gathered in phase 1, one per entry.

symptom.description: kind: 'bug' only. 1-2 sentence description of the observable, user-facing behavior.

rootCause.description: kind: 'bug' only. Technical explanation with file:line references. If investigation hasn't confirmed a root cause yet, say so explicitly rather than guessing, and use openQuestions for what's left to verify.

expected.description: What correct behavior looks like, e.g. from a comparable working mark.

actual.description: What the buggy code actually does.

comparison.description: kind: 'bug' only, optional. Side-by-side comparison of correct vs. actual behavior, e.g. a working similar mark's encoding vs. the buggy one.

edgeCases.description: kind: 'feature' required, 'bug' optional. See README.md for the standard edge-case checklist (empty data, single point, many series, long labels, breakpoints, light/dark background, S1/S2 parity, accessibility, interaction conflicts).

touchesHoverAnimation.description: The mouse-hover animation system (isAnimate gate, hoverAnimationUtils.ts, usermeta.animatedMark).

touchesControlledHighlight.description: The externally-controlled highlight system (CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_TABLE/SERIES), driven by props/state rather than mouse position.

touchesTooltipOrPopover.description: The interactive-mark system (isInteractive, voronoi hover overlay, interactiveMarkName, COMPONENT_NAME popover-content matching).

requiresNewSignalOrScale.description: A new Vega signal (needs a symmetric set/clear) or a new/extended facet scale (color/lineType/opacity).

requiresS1S2Parity.description: Whether the mirrored vega-spec-builder <-> vega-spec-builder-s2 file needs the same change (feature) or the same fix / a same-symptom check (bug).

notes.description: Free-text elaboration for any flag set to true above.

change.description: For kind: 'feature', what changes in this file. For kind: 'bug', the file's role (bug location vs. reference) and a proposed fix direction, not a committed implementation.

lines.description: Approximate line range at time of authoring, e.g. '88-129'. May drift — re-locate by symbol name if stale.

openQuestions.description: Anything unresolved that reviewers should weigh in on.

relatedIssues.description: Optional. IDs of other specs (features or bugs) related to this one — e.g. a narrower/broader variant of the same underlying defect discovered during investigation or implementation, or a follow-up filed as a result of this one.
